description.value: Ajiya Sushi is a Japanese restaurant situated on West 4th Avenue in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, a street that serves as a major cycling corridor with dedicated infrastructure. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the area. Its location on one of the city's busiest cycling routes gives it natural appeal as a mid-ride or end-of-ride meal option.
